subject: ATAN function
notes: FUNCTION ATAN(1000000000000000000) in the printed format (pb65_bounded_returned_value_landing): the returned value lies strictly below 15.11.4 r1's OPEN pi/2 bound, so the nine-place truncation is 1.570796326. pi/2 is not representable at scale 9, so the open-vs-closed distinction is not observable in this line. retired-witness: conformance:cases/15.10.4-Returned-value-rule/pb65_codomain_clamp (renamed to pb65_bounded_returned_value_landing by kb/Work PB3829)
